description: People DO NOT CARE. And I mean that in the nicest way possible 😂 I know filming in public or putting yourself out there online can feel terrifying, but I promise you, most people are far too busy thinking about themselves to worry about what you're doing. You're a background character in their day, not the main event. They'll probably forget about you five minutes later. And the funny thing is, when you start seeing success, those same people will be asking how you did it. So film the video. Post the content. Stop worrying about people who aren't even thinking about you. 👏
